index.title: tacto — Web studio in Paris: simple, beautiful websites that stay yours
index.description: Web studio in Paris: custom websites, simple and beautiful, that you edit yourself. And that stay yours.

tarifs.title: Pricing — tacto
tarifs.description: €450 the first year, then €150 per year. Custom website up to 5 pages, hosting, edits and 40 credits a year included. The site stays yours.

home.label: Web studio
home.title: Simple websites that <mark>draw</mark> people in.
home.lead: Businesses, brands, nonprofits, freelancers: we build your custom website, simple and beautiful. You edit your texts whenever you like, we handle the rest.
home.edit_text: Texts, prices, hours, news: as often as you like, free. The layout never breaks.
home.credits_text: Photos, a new section, a form: small changes within 24 business hours, a clear deadline for the rest.
home.tech_text: Hosting, security, updates: included, and off your mind.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: One yearly price. <mark>All</mark> included.
pricing.lead: Paid once a year, no monthly subscription.
first: Your custom website, up to 5 pages
Works on mobile, tablet and computer
One round of changes at delivery
Your own space to edit texts, prices and hours, as often as you like
next: Your own space to edit your texts, as often as you like
pricing.credits_lead: Text changes are unlimited and free. For anything else, send a request from your space and you instantly see how many credits it takes. Small changes are done within 24 business hours; for bigger ones, we give you a clear deadline.
pricing.credits_note: Online sales, payments, apps…: these are new projects, quoted separately.
pricing.own_lead: The site's code, your texts and your photos belong to you. If you stop, we hand over all the site's files, ready to be hosted elsewhere. Hosting and your editing space end at the end of the paid year.

credit_labels.menu: Adding a menu or catalogue item

items.title: A homepage, no commitment
items.text: We design your site's homepage with your real content. You see it before you commit.

items.title: You approve, we build
items.text: If you like it, you approve and pay for the year. We build the rest of the site (up to 5 pages), then one round of changes in a single back-and-forth.

items.title: Your domain name
items.text: We transfer yours, or buy one for you. If it needs buying, it isn't included (usually €10–20 a year).

items.title: Live
items.text: Your site goes live. From then on, your credits take over.
